# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: UAE 1970 on actions — event hooks.
## COLDWAR | UAE 1970. Generated by tools/uae_1970/compile.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			UAE = { COLDWAR_UAE_initialise = yes }
		}
	}

	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { tag = UAE COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes } COLDWAR_UAE_daily_update = yes }
		}
	}

	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { tag = UAE COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes } COLDWAR_UAE_politics_tick = yes COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes }
		}
	}

	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { tag = UAE COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes } COLDWAR_UAE_politics_tick = yes COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes }
		}
	}
}
